title: Busy live tables save every action
summary: When several people act at the same moment in a shared campaign, every action now saves instead of one of them asking you to retry.
items: If the table is busy, the server waits a moment and tries again by itself, and your app sends a busy action once more automatically. Nothing is applied twice.
Joining, naming the campaign, switching between Live and turn-based play, managing seats, skipping a turn and ending the session also wait and retry when someone else is acting at the same time.
If an action still cannot be saved, it stays pending on your device as before, ready to retry.
